# Set up environment

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(httr, jsonlite, tidyverse, here)

# Clear envionrment
rm(list = ls())

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L0/001_retrieve_EPT_obs_iNat_API.qmd")
```

# Establish API parameters

```{r}
#| label: est-api-param
# base API url
API_URL <- "https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/observations"
PER_PAGE <- 200 # Max records per request (API maximum)
USER_NAME <- "iNat user: kmtorres" # allows iNat to reach out about API traffic concerns

# Variables for pagination
last_obs_id <- 0
total_downloaded <- 0
page_num <- 1

# Taxon variables
taxon_id_list <- c(48011, 47504, 62164)
taxon_name_list <- c("Ephemeroptera", "Plecoptera", "Trichoptera")
taxon_was_updated <- c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)
taxon_last_id_list <- list()
taxon_datasets <- list()

# iNat Taxon ID
#ephe <- 48011
#plec <- 47504
#tric <- 62164
```

# Retrieve data from API

## Check existing data

Observation data was pulled between November 3rd and 4th 2025 for EPT taxa.
However, the study period is from 2000-2025, so additional data needs to be
pulled to complete the period.

If starting from scratch, skip this cell and change `last_obs_id` to 0 for the [API call parameters](#retrieve-api-data)

```{r}
#| label: check-exist-data
#| message: false
get_id <- function(x) {
  csv_file <- here(
    "data",
    "L0",
    sprintf(
      "001%s_obs_%s.csv",
      letters[x],
      str_to_lower(taxon_name_list[x])
    )
  )

  if (file.exists(csv_file)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\nExisting observations file found for: %s\n",
      taxon_name_list[x]
    ))

    id_num <- read_csv(csv_file) |>
      pull(id) |>
      max()
    return(id_num)
  } else {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\nNo existing observations file found for: %s\n",
      taxon_name_list[x]
    ))
  }
}

# Get max observation id, if existing observation data exists
for (x in seq_along(taxon_id_list)) {
  taxon_last_id_list <- append(taxon_last_id_list, get_id(x))
}
```

## Retrieve new data

```{r}
#| label: retrieve-api-data
# Loop through taxa
for (x in seq_along(taxon_id_list)) {
  id <- taxon_id_list[x]
  name <- taxon_name_list[x]
  cat(sprintf(
    "Starting download for observations of %s (ID=%d): ...\n",
    name,
    id
  ))

  current_taxon_page <- list()
  total_downloaded <- 0
  page_num <- 1

  # Sets last observation id to 0 if no existing data is available
  if (length(taxon_last_id_list) > 1) {
    last_obs_id <- taxon_last_id_list[x]
    taxon_was_updated[x] <- TRUE
  } else {
    last_obs_id <- 0
    taxon_was_updated[x] <- FALSE
  }

  # Loop through API pages
  while (TRUE) {
    # Query parameters
    params <- list(
      taxon_id = id,
      per_page = PER_PAGE,
      order_by = 'id', # required to use id_above
      order = 'asc', # required to use id_above
      id_above = last_obs_id
    )

    # Make API request
    response <- GET(API_URL, query = params, user_agent(USER_NAME)) # specify for iNat

    # Check for HTTP errors
    if (http_error(response)) {
      cat(sprintf(
        "\n!!! HTTP Error on page %d: %s !!!\n",
        page_num,
        http_status(response)$message
      ))
      break
    }

    # Parse JSON response
    content <- content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
    data <- fromJSON(content, flatten = TRUE)

    results <- data$results

    if (length(results) == 0) {
      cat("\n*** Reached the end of the results. ***\n")
      break # Exit loop if no results
    }

    # Extract data and update variables
    # 'results' is a data frame when fromJSON is used
    current_taxon_page[[page_num]] <- results

    total_downloaded <- total_downloaded + nrow(results)

    # Update the last_obs_id for the next request
    # The last observation's ID is the largest on this page
    last_obs_id <- max(results$id)

    cat(sprintf(
      "Page %d: Downloaded %d observations. %d saved, %d remaining. Next ID_Above: %d\n",
      page_num,
      nrow(results),
      total_downloaded,
      data$total_results,
      last_obs_id
    ))

    page_num <- page_num + 1

    # Respect the API rate limit
    Sys.sleep(5)
  }

  # Save a serpate dataframe for each taxon
  if (length(current_taxon_page) > 0) {
    single_taxon_df <- bind_rows(current_taxon_page)

    # Use the taxon name as the key for the taxon df
    taxon_datasets[[name]] <- single_taxon_df

    cat(sprintf(
      "\n>> Finished %s. Saved %d rows to taxon_datasets[['%s']]\n",
      name,
      nrow(single_taxon_df),
      name
    ))
  } else {
    cat("\nNo observations found.\n")
  }
}
```

# Save data and file

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This will write over the existing files by joining the existing data with new data if the API found new observation records

```{r}
#| label: export-data
for (x in seq_along(taxon_id_list)) {
  name <- taxon_name_list[x]
  file_prefix <- sprintf("001%s_obs_%s", letters[x], name)

  cat(sprintf(
    "\nChecking if files already exist for %s and if a CSV and RDS exist under the file name: %s",
    name,
    file_prefix
  ))

  # create file paths
  rds_file <- here("data", "L0", paste0(file_prefix, ".rds"))
  csv_file <- here("data", "L0", paste0(file_prefix, ".csv"))

  # Add existing data to new data, if it exists
  if (file.exists(csv_file) && file.exists(rds_file) && taxon_was_updated[x]) {
    cat(sprintf("\nJoining existing data and new data for %s\n", name))

    # Bind with RDS file because lists within the object are lost in CSV
    existing_rds <- readRDS(rds_file)
    taxon_datasets[[name]] <- bind_rows(taxon_datasets[[name]], existing_rds)
  } else {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\nNo occurrence data already exists. Creating new files for %s\n",
      name
    ))
  }
  # Save rds and csv files for each taxon; (rewrites existing files)
  saveRDS(taxon_datasets[[name]], file = rds_file)
  write_csv(taxon_datasets[[name]], file = csv_file)
}
```
